correctness.rationale: The projection row-sum identity is exact in both fields. For a<1/2 each positive c_j gives a lower bound L≥1+(Σ1/c_j)^−1 attained by aligned nonnegative factors. Finite-dimension support/zero-coefficient cases and λ<2 were checked analytically. 1,001 independent exact rational and linear-program configurations passed; not substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: Compared full primary 2026 manuscript to the exact new statement: its Proposition 3.1 and Theorem 2.4 produce only the weaker 4−3λ denominator, on λ<4/3, over real scalars. value.rationale: The 2026 codimension-one comparison has a 4ε near-unit slope and λ<4/3 restriction; the refined estimate has 2ε near-unit slope, applies to every finite hyperplane λ<2 and to complex scalars, and has a full equality classification for the explicitly motivated coordinate-frame distortion. This is a genuine dimension-free quantitative improvement for a natural family rather than a numerical table, although it does not solve the unrestricted sharp Banach--Mazur problem.
